intended_object: The natural bijection (an isomorphism in Type) between multiplicative equivalences X ≃* Y of types with multiplication and isomorphisms MagmaCat.of X ≅ MagmaCat.of Y in the category of magmas; the additive version is generated by to_additive. Inferred from the docstring and name.
explanation: The body maps an equivalence e to e.toMagmaCatIso and an isomorphism i to i.magmaCatIsoToMulEquiv. Since the file compiles, these maps are mutually inverse, so the definition is exactly the stated correspondence between equivalences and categorical isomorphisms. The only assumptions are [Mul X] and [Mul Y] on types in an arbitrary universe, which is the most general setting for magmas. This is Mathlib's own declaration of the statement; the analogous results for other algebraic categories follow the same pattern (e.g. mulEquivIsoGroupIso for groups).
